items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1968-11-30
items.q: to tell you anything about his playing other than listening at his records, nah, I couldn't tell you. Because I was real small when he was that guy.

ctx.x: What about King Oliver? Do you remember?

Yeah, but I was small when King Oliver left the hour and he played. But to tell you anything about his playing other than listening at his records, nah, I couldn't tell you. Because I was real small when he was that guy. Yeah. Couldn't get around much, you know, being so young, you know.
When were you born? 1902, September 9th. What about, um, did you ever hear any music in the district? Yeah. Did you ever play that?
